in_sanskrit.name: भुषण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is adorned with various ornaments, or a decoration itself. In Hinduism, Bhushana is a term used for the deities and their idols, which are adorned with various ornaments and decorations.

in_hindi.name: भुषण
in_hindi.long_meaning: भू: earth, षण: to adorn. A term used to denote something that is beautiful and ornamental.

in_tamil.name: புசனம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: பு: wealth, சனம்: to decorate. A term used to denote something that is beautiful and adorned with wealth.

in_telugu.long_meaning: భూ: earth, శణ: to adorn. A term used to denote something that is beautiful and adorned with various ornaments and decorations.

in_marathi.name: Bhushana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhushana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who adorns or is adorned with beautiful ornaments or virtues.
